messages:
tara: quick follow-up from the postmortem — quiet-hours paging for ingest-worker spiked again. want clear owners, short mitigations, and verification steps.

ben: i'll take alert tuning. short fix: move rule from 1m instant -> 12m rolling avg and require 2 consecutive windows. also add a deploy suppression tag for 20m. i'll open a PR today with before/after fire counts. :+1:

yasmin: i'll own dedupe and routing. plan: dedupe_key = job_id:zone; during quiet-hours route to `oncall-late` rota and label `quiet_window=true`. will test in staging and post results. PR target: Thu.

chao: ops tasks: add a runbook quick-action on the alert card (cancel job, throttle input) and a short escalation checklist for oncall. ETA: 4 business days.

oncall-bot: incident 2967894321 resolved by tara \u2014 duration 52m \u2014 postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2967894321 (auto)

tara: acceptance criteria: 14-day rolling reduction >= 75% in pages during quiet-hours, plus runbook steps documented and one manual cancel test performed. owners must attach dashboard screenshots to close items.

ben: config snippet i'll add to the PR:
```yaml
alert: ingest-worker-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(12m) > 0.06
require: 2_consecutive_windows
suppression:
  when_tag: deploy=true
  window: 20m
dedupe_key: "job_id:zone"
```

yasmin: routing snippet ready: `route: oncall-late`, `labels: {quiet_window: true}`. staging dedupe collapsed 5 duplicates into 1. posting logs shortly.

chao: runbook draft added to ops playbooks repo. includes cancel command, throttle steps, and 'bypass suppression' criteria if db errors correlate. will add screenshot checklist once PRs land.

tara: timeline recap: ben PR today, yasmin PR Thu, chao runbook in 4d. checkpoint next Friday 11am to review metrics. /remind @ops-team checkpoint next_friday 11:00

ben: PR up (WIP) with synthetic test results: pre ~22 fires/night, synthetic prediction ~3/night. tagging for review.

yasmin: staging logs: dedupe collapsed and routing to oncall-late works as expected. will open PR by EOD Thu.

chao: added the one-click action to the alert card in staging; will promote to prod after PRs merge.

tara: great. owners, please update the postmortem action list with PR links and acceptance screenshots. i'll close items once criteria verified. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
